title: Coherent higher direct images of a projective morphism
statement:
Let $S$ be locally Noetherian, let $f:X\to S$ be
projective, and let
$\mathcal F$ be a coherent module.
Then each higher direct image
$R^qf_*\mathcal F$ is coherent.
For an embedding $X\hookrightarrow\mathbf P^n_S$, it is zero for $q>n$.

proof.text:
Work over an affine open $V=\operatorname{Spec}(A)\subset S$ and
put $X_V=f^{-1}(V)$. The fixed projective embedding restricts to
$X_V\hookrightarrow\mathbf P^n_A$. By
[lem-pc-projective-coherent-finiteness], the modules
$M^q=H^q(X_V,\mathcal F)$ are finite over $A$ and vanish for $q>n$.

Since $f$ is projective, $f_V:X_V\to V$ is quasi-compact and separated, and restriction to the open $V$ commutes with higher direct images: $R^qf_*\mathcal F|_V=R^q(f_V)_*(\mathcal F|_{X_V})$ (restriction to an open is exact and preserves injective modules). By [lem-pc-cohomology-sections-affine-base], applied to $f_V$ over the affine $V$,

$$
\Gamma\bigl(V,R^qf_*\mathcal F|_V\bigr)\cong H^q(X_V,\mathcal F)=M^q .
$$

By [lem-pc-finite-support-hi], $R^qf_*\mathcal F|_V$ is quasi-coherent, so by [lem-weil-pbc-affine-tilde-gamma-adjunction] (3) the counit identifies it with $\widetilde{M^q}$. A surjection $A^{r}\twoheadrightarrow M^q$ (step 1) gives a surjection $\mathcal O_V^{\oplus r}\twoheadrightarrow\widetilde{M^q}$, so $\widetilde{M^q}$ is quasi-coherent of finite type, hence coherent by [pqf-lem-coherent-ft-locnoeth], $V$ being Noetherian. For $q>n$, $M^q=0$ gives $R^qf_*\mathcal F|_V=0$. Since the affine opens $V$ cover $S$, the statement follows on $S$.
